name: cemi
description: Hover an environment variable to see what the key is for, when it expires and how to rotate it, without ever showing its value. Warns when a secret from your vault is written in a file.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Cemí only reads cemi.toml and runs the cemi program you installed, never one from the workspace.

commands.title: Look for vault values in this file

cemi.path.markdownDescription: The cemi program: a name looked up in `PATH`, or a full path. On Windows, point to `cemi.exe`.

cemi.hover.enabled.description: Show what a variable is for, when it expires and how it is rotated when you hover it.

cemi.scan.onSave.description: When a file is saved, warn about values of your vaults written in it.

cemi.scan.exclude.description: Glob patterns of files not checked on save.

cemi.timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for cemi, in milliseconds.
